pattern: SELECT [A-ZA-Z_]+ FROM ([A-ZA-Z]+\s+JOIN\s+)[A-ZA-Z]+ AS (\w+) ON ([A-ZA-Z]+\.id) = (\w+)\.([A-Za-z0-9]+) WHERE ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.([A-Za-z0-9]+) != '(.*?)' GROUP BY [A-ZA-Z_]+ HAVING COUNT\(([A-Za-z0-9]+)\.id) = 0
correction: SELECT id NOT IN (SELECT channel FROM cartoon WHERE directed_by = 'Ben Jones')

metadata.description: This rule corrects incorrect joins between tables, where the join condition is based on id and there's an unnecessary group by clause.
